title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the Dec 19 1973 Tampa show, with a stellar performance highlighted by “Here Comes Sunshine” and “The Greatest Story Ever Told.”
ai_review.review: All four reviewers give this recording five‑star marks, praising both sets as consistently strong and noting that Charlie Miller’s transfer delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality. The night is remembered for the hot “Here Comes Sunshine,” a soaring “Greatest Story Ever Told,” and Jerry’s guitar tone that fans describe as pure ear‑candy.

ai_rating.rationale: Uniform 5‑star ratings and enthusiastic comments on both musical performance and audio fidelity place the show and recording at the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s transfer is praised as crisp and flawless; no drop‑outs or balance issues were reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are described as strong and well‑sequenced, giving the December ’73 run a satisfying arc that fans consider a perfect send‑off for the year.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is highlighted as “ear candy” (Fender Red Knob) and generally praised throughout the night.
